claims.label: Overall annual-heating compression fidelity
claims.exact_claim: In v2, eligible-stratum-weighted held-out annual useful-heating RMSE against detailed-input outputs from the same model (pooled→group-conditional) is Padova 1828.20→1787.94 kWh, Bolzano 2633.86→2565.53 kWh, Roma 1437.68→1411.16 kWh, Palermo 1215.81→1196.74 kWh; paired weighted MSE differences (conditional minus pooled) are Padova -145596.59 kWh², Bolzano -355285.79 kWh², Roma -75546.73 kWh², Palermo -46011.95 kWh². These conditional model-reference deviations await fresh independent review and are not measured prediction errors.

claims.label: Overall individual-peak compression fidelity
claims.exact_claim: In v2, eligible-stratum-weighted held-out expected-individual-annual-maximum sensible-load RMSE against detailed-input outputs from the same model (pooled→group-conditional) is Padova 4.7155→4.6015 kW, Bolzano 2.3658→2.3571 kW, Roma 3.5514→3.4742 kW, Palermo 3.2389→3.1945 kW; paired weighted MSE differences (conditional minus pooled) are Padova -1.0627 kW², Bolzano -0.0413 kW², Roma -0.5421 kW², Palermo -0.2855 kW². The prediction is a weighted expectation of individual annual maxima, not a coincident or diversified system peak.

claims.label: Within-model detailed-input spread persists
claims.exact_claim: For Padova-coordinate weather the 32 held-out detailed-input model annual useful-heating outputs span 5538.60–13145.26 kWh, while the four group-conditional mixture predictions span 7736.55–7953.89 kWh and the pooled prediction is 7834.86 kWh; the four branch mixtures compress substantially more respondent-input variation than they retain.

claims.label: Bounded interpretation of conditional mixtures
claims.exact_claim: The v2 conditional branch mixtures have lower eligible-stratum-weighted overall within-model RMSE than pooled branch weights for annual useful heating and expected individual annual maxima at each of four TMY exposures, but Bolzano subgroup peak counterexamples, large detailed-input spread, extra conditional parameters and absent measurements prevent a blanket algorithm-superiority or empirical-accuracy conclusion.
